description: J-Cain Cream is a KFDA-approved Korean high-strength topical anaesthetic formulated with 10.56% lidocaine for use before minimally invasive aesthetic and dermatological procedures. It is a single-agent amide-anaesthetic cream widely used in clinics to reduce procedural discomfort during injections, laser and needling work. Supplied in professional 30 g and 500 g presentations for clinic dispensing.
howItWorks: Lidocaine, an amide-type local anaesthetic, diffuses through the stratum corneum and reversibly blocks voltage-gated sodium channels in cutaneous sensory nerve endings, interrupting the initiation and conduction of pain signals. Applying a thick layer under occlusion raises the temperature and hydration of the skin, driving the drug into the epidermis and superficial dermis so that the treatment area becomes numb before the procedure begins.
composition: Lidocaine 10.56% (105.6 mg/g) as the sole active anaesthetic. Excipients reported include macrogolglycerol hydroxystearate, carbomer (974P), sodium hydroxide and purified water.
usageNotes: Apply a thick, even layer to intact skin and cover with occlusive film for the manufacturer-stated contact time before the procedure. Observe maximum treatable surface area and contact time to limit systemic lidocaine absorption, and reduce dose on thin or highly vascular skin. Remove the cream completely and cleanse the field before any energy-based (laser/RF) procedure. Avoid application to broken, inflamed or infected skin; professional (clinic) use only.

howItWorks: Lidocaine penetrates the epidermis and reversibly blocks voltage-gated sodium channels in cutaneous nerve endings, preventing the depolarisation that transmits pain. Applied thickly under occlusion, the cream hydrates the stratum corneum and enhances drug uptake into the superficial skin layers so the target area is desensitised before the procedure.

Remove residue thoroughly before energy-based (laser/RF) procedures. Do not use on damaged, inflamed or infected skin; intended for professional use.

description: Neo-Cain Pro Cream (marketed as Neo Pro Cream) is the dual-anaesthetic variant of the Neo-Cain line, combining lidocaine 2.5% with prilocaine 2.5% in a eutectic-type formulation. The prilocaine component is intended to extend the depth and duration of anaesthesia versus a single-agent lidocaine cream, making it useful for longer or deeper procedures. Supplied in clinic and bulk formats for professional use.
howItWorks: Lidocaine and prilocaine are both amide-type anaesthetics that reversibly block voltage-gated sodium channels in cutaneous nerve endings. Combined in roughly equal parts they form a eutectic mixture with a lower melting point, allowing a higher proportion of active drug to penetrate intact skin under occlusion; the two agents together broaden and prolong the numbing effect through the epidermis and superficial dermis.
composition: Lidocaine 2.5% (25 mg/g) and prilocaine 2.5% (25 mg/g), a combined 5% dual-caine eutectic-type cream.
usageNotes: Apply a thick layer to intact skin and occlude for the manufacturer-stated contact time, which is typically longer for a eutectic 5% cream than for high-strength single-agent lidocaine. Observe maximum surface area and contact time to limit systemic absorption of both actives, and take particular care in patients at risk of methaemoglobinaemia given the prilocaine content. Remove completely before energy-based procedures; avoid broken or inflamed skin; professional use only.
